link_resolution_contract.result: Both new tests passed; all thirteen openobsidian-doc tests passed on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows.
behavior: Returns explicit resolved, unresolved, ambiguous or external status without changing source.
Resolves same-directory and current-note targets, optional Markdown extensions, and unambiguous basename references.
Normalizes percent-encoded targets, backslash separators and a leading ./ for matching while preserving original reference text.
Sorts ambiguous candidates and retains candidates for unresolved paths.
Retains heading/block subpaths on references but does not validate their targets.

limitations: Heading and block subpath identities are not source-validated yet.
Fenced-code and inline-code contexts are not filtered yet; references must not drive edits until this handling and safe update planning land.
This slice only resolves paths; it does not create rename/move plans or write vault files.
The unchanged-plugin reports are feasibility-only; broad legacy compatibility remains Pending.
No local executable validation was run.
finding: R2.5 passed exact-SHA GitHub Actions on Ubuntu, macOS and Windows. Rust formatting, the parallel test group, thirteen document tests per OS, Clippy, layering, native builds, unchanged-plugin feasibility probes and all five companion workflows passed.
scope: This milestone adds path-level link resolution outcomes. C03 remains pending until source-aware heading/block validation, code-context filtering and safe reference updates are implemented and verified.
